statement_blocker: The catalog does not select the ordinary prime-counting function, Chebyshev theta, Chebyshev psi, or a checked package connecting them. It omits the exact or asymptotic relation, constants and their quantifiers, threshold, natural or real domain, floor and endpoint conventions, ordered binders, hypotheses, conclusion, whether both directions form one root, and every finite or degenerate case. Choosing familiar Chebyshev bounds from memory would invent proposition-changing mathematics.
